text:
jason: Heads-up — SeaChange (prospect) asked for a migration POC from CompetitorX -> Redwood. Scope: Gen endpoint, chat session handoff, and embeddings. They want parity checks, cost delta, and security Qs answered. Timeline: demo in 7 business days. Can we list technical blockers?
lina: Quick notes on adapter work: field mapping (CompX `req_id` -> `x-request-id`), error-code translation, rate-limit header compatibility, and webhook signature verification. Streaming semantics differ slightly. We'll do a compat shim in the POC.
omar: For pricing: they charge per 1k tokens + a transform multiplier for embeddings. I'll model three usage tiers (low/med/high) and show per-1M token delta vs Redwood hosted/dedicated. Also include an example bill conversion for their current monthly numbers.
claire: Security: SeaChange requires SSO + customer KMS + audit trail with per-request metadata for 90 days. If they need HSM-backed keys for Private, add ~10 business days. Also want egress IPs and data-residency statement for contract.
jason: Eval metrics — what do we run? Exact-match for structured outputs, token-delta table, and a small semantic-similarity set for chat. We should include a deterministic seed set.
lina: Plan: 1) build lightweight proxy that maps request/response fields; 2) prompt-normalizer to apply stop sequences and default params; 3) smoke tests: 200 seed prompts + 30 chat sessions + embeddings corpus. Minimal proxy snippet below:```bash
# proxy example (pseudo)
curl -X POST https://redwood.poc.internal/proxy 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $POC_KEY' 
  -H 'X-Comp-ReqId: $REQ' 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-base-001","input": "${PROMPT}", "max_tokens": 256}'
```
lina: Also map CompX streaming chunk shape to Redwood's chunk shape in the shim to avoid client-side parser changes.
omar: I'll run a 48h synthetic workload and collect: total tokens, avg tokens/resp, tokenization delta, 50th/95th/99th latency, and fuzz-score for semantics (cosine on embeddings + BLEU-ish for structured).
sec-bot: Security ticket created: SR-4582. Owner: claire. SLA: 72h initial response.
claire: Legal asks: will the shim persist any PII or logs? For the POC we set `data_retention: off` and rotate keys daily. I'll draft a short statement for the SOW.
jason: Blockers to call out now: webhook signature approach (they verify HMAC using their secret), rate-limit retry semantics (CompX returns 429 with `retry-after`), and streaming session IDs for chat continuity.
lina: On webhook signatures: we'll forward the CompX signature header unchanged and provide a verification helper for their infra. For rate limits we'll map Redwood 429s to CompX style response headers in the shim.
omar: Cost-note: For a canonical case (1M gen tokens + 200k embed tokens/month) preliminary numbers show Redwood hosted ~15% cheaper than CompetitorX at low volume, Dedicated breaks even around 8M gen tokens. I'll attach table after the run.
sec-bot: POC environment provisioned: redwood-poc-seachange-171600. Access TTL: 21 days.
jason: Can we do a pre-demo dry run 24h before the customer demo? Also need an explicit list of any behavior differences to present (3 bullets max).
lina: Dry run ok. Behavior diffs to flag: tokenization offsets on certain unicode punctuation, default trailing-newline handling in structured outputs, and streaming chunk boundary semantics.
claire: I'll prepare answers for the security questionnaire today and add the KMS integration diagram. If they push for encryption at rest with customer-managed keys on Hosted, note that it's available via our Dedicated/HYBRID offering.
omar: Deliverables I'll produce: cost comparison sheet, one-page SOW draft, synthetic workload logs, and fuzz/delta report.
jason: OK owners — Lina: proxy + smoke tests + delta report. Omar: pricing + SOW + synthetic run. Claire: security questionnaire + contract wording. I'll own demo coordination.
sec-bot: Reminder: logs retention for the POC defaults to 7 days; extendable on request.
jason: Thanks — post any EOD blockers here. :thumbsup:
